tagline: Class diagrams drawn from parser facts, not guesses
brief: A Claude Code and Codex plugin that extracts classes and relations with tree-sitter and lets the agent decide only what to show. The mark must feel precise, honest and crafted, stand apart from blue developer-tool marks, and survive at 16 px in a plugin directory, a favicon and a terminal.
criteria: Success: one idea in one sentence, distinct from triangle marks in the category, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed.

concepts.name: Set Square
concepts.idea: The UML inheritance arrowhead is a draftsman's set square.
rationale: Name and product in one shape: the draftsman's tool and the diagram's arrow
Drafting Amber, the tinted acrylic of a set square, stands apart from blue developer tools
Heavy object line, light connecting line: drafting convention, and it keeps the mark from reading as a sign post
Small-size cut keeps the set-square opening visible at 16 px

recommendation: Set Square — use the two-tone mark on Ink tiles for plugin and app icons, the horizontal lockup in the README, and the small cut for favicons.
